questions.question: Two different positions of the same dice with faces 3, 7, 8, 2, 9 and 4 are shown below. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one having 4.
questions.questionHtml: Two different positions of the same dice with faces 3, 7, 8, 2, 9 and 4 are shown below. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one having 4.
questions.solution:
As 8 is common on both the dices, it is clear that 3, 7, 2, and 9 are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. 4 will be opposite to it.

​

Opposite pairs:

3 → 2

7 → 9

8 → 4

So, the opposite side of "4" will be side "8".

questions.question: Six letters K, L, M, N, O and P are written on different faces of a dice. Three positions of this dice are shown in the figure. Find the letter on the face opposite to M.

Six letters K, L, M, N, O and P are written on different faces of a dice. Three positions of this dice are shown in the figure.
Find the letter on the face opposite to M.
questions.solution:
As K is common on both the dices I and III, it is clear that M, O, N, and L are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. P will be opposite to it.

 ​

Opposite pairs:

M → N

O → L

K → P

So, the opposite side of "M" will be side "N".

questions.question: All of the letters in the word ‘WISDOM’ are arranged in alphabetical order. How many letters are there in the English alphabetical series between the letter which is third from the left end and the one which is second from the right end in the new letter-cluster thus formed?

questions.solution:
Given word W I S D O M

Rearranged in alphabetical order

 D I M O S W

Thus, the new formed letter cluster → D I M O S W

Now, the number of letters are there in the English alphabetical series between the letter which is third from the left end and the one which is second from the right end:

(Left end) D I M O S W (Right end)

Thus, five letters i.e N, O, P, Q, and R are between M and S.
